articles.title: This Ancient Volcano Froze the Andes in Their Baby Stage — 22 Million Years Ago
articles.summary: A massive eruption in Chile buried the young Andes under volcanic rock, preserving a 22-million-year-old snapshot. Scientists say the mountains grew slowly and steadily, not in a sudden burst.

articles.title: Colbert's Late Show Wins Six Emmys in Final Season as Widow's Bay Breaks Records
articles.summary: The Late Show with Stephen Colbert won six Emmys for its final season, while new comedy Widow's Bay took home 14 — a record. Mariska Hargitay hosted and Taylor Swift made a surprise cameo.

articles.title: Toby Samuel's 'Surreal' Rise: From Challenger Tour to Davis Cup Hero
articles.summary: Toby Samuel, 23, climbed from small tournaments to Great Britain's Davis Cup team in one year. He made his debut at three Grand Slams and says the call-up was 'one of the best moments of my life.'
